scope: Coupled fault screen: battery and supercapacitor reject regen, central 12V/CORE/CAN revoked, BMS main path opened, with simultaneous and skewed event orders; compare actual installed FOC torque credit with one- and two-FOC local-brake counterfactuals.

vehicle.mass_status: comparison assumption inherited from 15kmh_3m model; not user-confirmed

auxiliary_load_basis: 5 W baseline; 30 W inherited bounded sensitivity; 70 W stress above the pump design input of approximately 21 V x 3 A plus logic. The 50/65/75 ms load-shedding transitions are comparison points, not measured or modeled at the pump switch level.
